# synology_ddns (Data Source)

Complete read-only inventory of configured DSM DDNS records. Empty records establish no configured DDNS object; authentication, unsupported, transport and malformed responses remain errors. Passwords are discarded, not redacted values in state. This never tests registration, refreshes external DNS or creates certificates.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "synology_ddns" "nas" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Inventory identity: ddns.
- `providers` (Set of String) Available DSM DDNS provider IDs. Custom provider URLs and embedded credentials are not exposed.
- `records` (Attributes Map) Configured records keyed by stable DSM record ID; use these keys for resource import. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--records))

<a id="nestedatt--records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `records`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Observed DDNS enabled flag.
- `heartbeat` (Boolean) Observed DDNS heartbeat flag.
- `hostname` (String) Observed DDNS hostname setting.
- `id` (String) Observed DDNS id setting.
- `ipv4_address` (String) Observed DDNS ipv4_address setting.
- `ipv4_interface` (String) Observed DDNS ipv4_interface setting.
- `ipv6_address` (String) Observed DDNS ipv6_address setting.
- `ipv6_interface` (String) Observed DDNS ipv6_interface setting.
- `network_mode` (String) Observed DDNS network_mode setting.
- `provider_id` (String) Observed DDNS provider_id setting.
- `status` (String) Observed DDNS status setting.
- `username` (String, Sensitive) Observed DDNS username setting.
